Write Crystal code implementing module Answer with self.lower_bound(values : Array(Int32), target : Int32) : Int32.
The input is sorted in nondecreasing order. Return the first index whose value is greater than or equal to target; return values.size if no such value exists. Handle empty input, duplicates, negative numbers, and Int32 minimum/maximum. Use O(log n) time and O(1) extra space. Do not mutate input. Use only the standard library; no I/O, files, processes or macros. Output only one complete Crystal code block, no explanation, no tests. Keep it short. This is a pure library function, not a command-line program.
